items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Well, you might say he's the weakest man in the band. But they have a colored trumpet player, he gets my vote. Alvin Alcorn.

ctx.x: Well, you might say he's the weakest man in the band. But they have a colored trumpet player, he gets my vote. Alvin Alcorn. What's his name? Alvin Alcorn. You could tell him I like his trumpet player.
I will, next time I go there.
